resolution.rationale: Hashing a small label space is reversible by enumeration and is not sanitization. The frozen visibility promise requires field-level capability separation.
resolution.selected_position: Restricted components receive only high-entropy random opaque handles and arm-neutral content projections; privileged mappings remain in a separate audit capability unavailable until authorized replay/audit.
resolution.required_change: Split ASSAY_ASSIGNMENT into PRIVILEGED_ASSAY_ASSIGNMENT, consumable only by PRIVILEGED_ROUTER/AUDIT/T14, and SANITIZED_CONTROLLER_ASSIGNMENT, consumable by CONTROLLER and containing only run/life/step-safe opaque IDs plus snapshot/seed/common-schema refs and no condition code. Split ROOT_SELECTION_RECEIPT into PRIVILEGED_ROOT_SELECTION_AUDIT and ADMITTED_ROOT_PROJECTION; WRITER receives only ordered admitted public evidence refs and a fresh opaque handle, never root_policy or its digest. Split CORPUS_MANIFEST provenance from TRAINING_CORPUS_PROJECTION; TRAINER receives only common-schema corpus bytes, row/token/update counts, recipe/base/tokenizer/seed handles, and no corpus_origin_ref, D1A/D1D type tag, construction_kind, root policy, or low-entropy hash. Allocate each restricted handle from a sealed 256-bit random nonce and expose only the handle/commitment; keep nonce and semantic mapping privileged. Remove CONTROLLER/WRITER/TRAINER inventory roles for privileged objects and add exact sanitized roles. T06/T10/T12/T14 must perform recursive field/type/tag/hash taint reachability and demonstrate that changing any privileged label while holding the allowed sanitized projection fixed cannot change restricted ingress or output bytes.

sources: machine_contract.md, model_view and operation_envelope schemas, object_inventory.json
disagreements.issue: MODEL_VIEW has no consumer and OPERATION_ENVELOPE has no view reference, so a retained output need not have been caused by the claimed state, ledger head, renderer, tokenizer, or input bytes.

positions.position: Retain MODEL_VIEW and OPERATION_ENVELOPE as separately hashed objects and rely on call IDs or prose to associate them.
Create an acyclic typed dispatch chain from exact view through raw output and parsed envelope to transition, plus a downstream closure receipt linking the post-state.

resolution.rationale: Call-ID convention cannot prove same-run/same-step causality. A downstream closure receipt is needed to bind the after transition without creating a dispatch-envelope-transition hash cycle.
resolution.selected_position: Use MODEL_VIEW -> MODEL_DISPATCH_RECEIPT -> OPERATION_ENVELOPE -> TRANSITION_EVENT -> MODEL_DISPATCH_CLOSURE_RECEIPT, all typed and same-run/same-step checked.
resolution.required_change: Inventory MODEL_DISPATCH_RECEIPT produced by MODEL_DISPATCH and consumed by CONTROLLER/TRANSITION_REDUCER/COLD_REPLAY. It must consume exactly one MODEL_VIEW plus PRE_STATE, preflight, run lock, model, tokenizer, prompt, adapter-or-null, and seed refs; bind run_id, assay_id, recipient_life_id, sample_ordinal, opaque instance, step/call ordinal, public STATE_BODY hash, matching ledger_head, exact rendered input BYTE_REF and token IDs/count, raw output BYTE_REF and token IDs/count, debit, and call status. OPERATION_ENVELOPE must replace duplicated unattached dispatch fields with one typed MODEL_DISPATCH_RECEIPT ref plus parse status and operation. TRANSITION_EVENT consumes that envelope. Inventory a downstream MODEL_DISPATCH_CLOSURE_RECEIPT consuming dispatch, envelope, transition event, POST_STATE_BODY, and POST_STATE_RECEIPT; enforce identical run/life/assay/instance/step/call identity and exact before/after hashes. This separation forbids a back-reference cycle. Add MODEL_DISPATCH and COLD_REPLAY roles to MODEL_VIEW and retain every closure in T14. Mutate each body/head/input/token/model/tokenizer/seed/debit/output/ordinal/before/after binding in T03/T08/T09/T10/T12 and reconstruct it without model execution in T14.

disagreements.issue: Gate, safety, missingness, and complete-life results use bare observation hashes or omit observation membership, allowing arbitrary, favorable, duplicate, swapped, or cross-run subsets.

positions.position: Use treatment/control/adverse observation hashes and membership_complete booleans without typed observation consumer roles.
Make observations first-class typed members and derive every pair, safety trial, endpoint coverage, gate, and result from one closed prospectively locked membership.

resolution.rationale: The estimand and D1A designated safety trials are not reconstructible unless every observation has one owned identity and exact membership role.
resolution.selected_position: Use typed OBSERVATION refs keyed by exact run/assay/life/condition/pair/endpoint/lower-unit ordinals and close all manifests and reducers over the same prospective set.
resolution.required_change: Extend OBSERVATION with run_id, condition_role, pair_id, lower_unit_ordinal, observation_ordinal, and exact endpoint ownership; define canonical observation key (run_id, assay_id, sample_ordinal, recipient_life_id, condition_role, pair_id, endpoint_id, lower_unit_ordinal, observation_ordinal). Replace gate_observation_ref treatment_observation_hash/control_observation_hash with typed refs roles TREATMENT_OBSERVATION and CONTROL_OBSERVATION; replace adverse observation_hash with typed ADVERSE_OBSERVATION; require same run, sample, pair, endpoint, and expected opposite condition roles. Add ordered OBSERVATION refs to COMPLETE_LIFE_MANIFEST and ENDPOINT_COVERAGE_RECEIPT and require exact equality with the run-locked gate membership, with no extras, omissions, duplicates, or cross-run refs. Add POPULATED_RUN_LOCK.d1a_primary_safety_trial_registry_ref naming exactly one false-selection and one NOT_FOUND lower-unit observation role per sample ordinal in canonical lower-unit order. Derive paired aggregation, missingness, safety, gate success, assay p-values, and Holm only from this closed membership. Inventory OBSERVATION consumer roles COMPLETE_LIFE, ENDPOINT_COVERAGE, GATE_REDUCER, SAFETY_REDUCER, MISSINGNESS_REDUCER, COLD_REPLAY, and RELEASE_REDUCER. T11 recomputes all results from refs; T12 rejects duplicate, swapped, unowned, omitted, extra, wrong-ordinal, and cross-run observations; T14 reconstructs identical membership twice.
